subject: Phased VPC onboarding — Mutual Action Plan & capacity addendum
messages:
From: Anna Svendsen <anna.svendsen@novahealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Phased VPC onboarding — initial ask

Hi Karthik,

We’re kicking off renewal planning for our Redwood Private footprint. We want to expand from 2 to 4 isolated VPC environments at renewal and introduce a short-term 'capacity bridge' to cover peak reporting windows while the new environments come online.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood share a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones for a phased rollout?
- Rough timeline for provisioning additional isolated clusters (network peering, IP ranges, KMS setup)
- Preliminary pricing/committed-capacity addendum and how proration will look for mid-cycle provisioning

We’re targeting a pilot cutover the week of Jun 21 if possible. Procurement is looped here for PO lead time.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Svendsen
VP Product Operations, NovaHealth
anna.svendsen@novahealth.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Anna Svendsen <anna.svendsen@novahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased VPC onboarding — initial ask

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear summary.

We’re aligned on a phased approach that minimizes risk and gives NovaHealth the ability to scale without service interruption. I’ve attached a draft MAP and a capacity worksheet for you and procurement to review. High-level proposal: 

Phase 0 — Capacity Bridge (15–45 days): allocate burst bridge nodes in your existing VPCs to absorb reporting peaks while new VPCs are provisioned. Charge will be pro-rated based on actual usage; see worksheet.

Phase 1 — Provisioning (2–3 weeks after signed amendment): networking & KMS prep, IP assignment, peering validation.

Phase 2 — Pilot cutover (week of Jun 21): run smoke tests in new VPCs with mirrored traffic, rollback window 48h.

Phase 3 — Final cut and SLA amendment: transition traffic fully and convert bridge nodes to reserved capacity or decommission.

Open items for Redwood to finalize with your team:
- Exact cluster counts per VPC (we currently estimate 2x medium clusters per new VPC)
- Preferred maintenance windows for cutover (night/weekend?)
- Signed amendment to the MSA to cover price/commitment changes

Next steps: Marissa will coordinate the amendment language and Monica will validate lead times for provisioning. If this looks good, I’ll drop a DocuSign amendment and lock the pilot dates.

Attachments: 20270601-novahealth-map-draft.xlsx, 20270601-capacity-worksheet.csv

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-02T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NovaHealth MAP & amendment work

Marissa / Monica — looping you both for quick alignment.

Marissa: please draft the amendment language that:
- Adds the extra committed capacity lines (4 new VPC envs + bridge nodes)
- Clarifies billing proration for bridge (we bill actual consumption for initial 30 days, then convert to committed if customer wants)
- Includes a 90-day SLA ramp for new VPCs (90 days of monitoring before full uptime SLA applies)

Monica: can you confirm:
- Lead times for isolated cluster provisioning (hardware vs cloud-burst options)
- Network pre-reqs we should ask NovaHealth to prepare (CIDR ranges, peering contacts, test IPs)
- Any limitations on KMS integrations / HSM lead time

I’ve penciled a pilot start week of Jun 21 — confirm if that’s feasible on your end.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-03T10:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: NovaHealth MAP & amendment work

Karthik / Marissa — quick notes from infra: 

Provisioning times (cloud-hosted Private VPCs):
- Standard isolated VPC with 2 medium clusters: ~10 business days after validated network pre-reqs and signed amendment.
- If NovaHealth wants physical on-prem ordering (air-gapped), lead time becomes 6–8 weeks for hardware procurement and validation.

Network pre-reqs:
- CIDR blocks for each new VPC (non-overlapping), public jumpbox IPs, peering contacts, SSL/TLS cert owner.
- KMS: if using customer-managed keys, we need the KMS admin contact and a test key ARN at least 5 business days prior to cutover.

Bridge nodes: we can spin temporary bridge pools within 24–48 hours but performance should be treated as best-effort until full reservation is in place. Billing will be consumption-based for the first 30 days; we’ll provide a daily cost and token-rate estimate.

Pilot week of Jun 21 is feasible if we get signed amendment and network details by Jun 11 EOD. Otherwise we move the pilot to Jul 5.

I’ll attach a short checklist and the SRE playbook snippets to the shared Drive.

—Monica
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Anna Svendsen <anna.svendsen@novahealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: NovaHealth Procurement <procurement@novahealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-08T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased VPC onboarding — Mutual Action Plan & capacity addendum

Karthik — thank you, the MAP and worksheet look good. Procurement has approved a PO for the bridge nodes and the first phase of provisioning. We’ve signed the PO and attached it to this thread (see procurement note).

Confirming items:
- We accept a Jun 21 pilot start provided the amendment is executed and Monica has the KMS/test keys by Jun 11.
- We want the bridge nodes to be billed as consumption for the first 30 days and then converted to a three-month committed line unless we opt out. Please include proration logic in the amendment.
- We’ll need an explicit rollback runbook included in the MAP.

Procurement will send the signed PO to the DocuSign amendment link when you provide it.

Thanks,
Anna

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Anna Svendsen <anna.svendsen@novahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2027-06-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased VPC onboarding — Mutual Action Plan & capacity addendum

Anna / team — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Next steps and confirmations: 

1) I’ve uploaded the finalized MAP with rollback runbook to the shared Drive and created a HubSpot milestone for the Jun 21 pilot. Link: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-9382-NH
2) DocuSign amendment is live (linked in Drive) — the amendment includes the proration clause: pro-rate bridge node charges by actual seconds of usage during the initial 30-day window; if converted to committed capacity, we apply a credit for any overlapping usage.
3) Monica confirmed the provisioning lead times. KMS test key requested by Jun 11 EOD.
4) Procurement: please route the signed PO to the DocuSign envelope ID 0f7a3b, then I’ll countersign and we’ll lock the pilot.

If I don’t see the signed amendment by Jun 14 we’ll need to move the pilot to Jul 5 per Monica’s note.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting NovaHealth onto the new isolated environments smoothly.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
